evidence: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory and pmon; model_runtime.EpisodeModel moves head and scaler to CPU and classify requires CPU input; cached feature fits own no CNN module.
observation: The PyTorch cached-head process holds a102MiB idle CUDA context despite all head parameters and feature minibatches remaining on CPU. It is part of this study, not an external competing workload.
resource_behavior: The next GPU-fit gate conservatively waits for any other compute-process context. CPU lane finishes independently and releases its context; no existing external/source job was interrupted.
scientific_scope: CPU head training is not relabeled GPU CNN training. GPU process cost is recorded only for the dedicated full-CNN controller; device utilization is explicitly a device observation.
